law: You don’t need to ask for additional authorization because your app can’t access the details for a suggestion until after a person chooses to share them by making a selection in the picker.
If the person taps Turn On Journaling Suggestions, the picker displays, and includes an information privacy banner.
To display the Journaling Suggestions picker, the system requires your app to have the entitlement.
